leftEvidence.title: Israel keeps Passover in the second year after Egypt

points.label: Place
points.left: The observance occurs in the wilderness of Sinai.
points.right: The observance occurs at Gilgal in the plains of Jericho.

points.label: Food
points.left: The text stresses statutes and appointed season.
points.right: Unleavened cakes and produce precede the end of manna.

points.label: Change
points.left: Israel remains between Egypt and the land.
points.right: The food supply changes after entry into the land.

payload.posture: Keep each Scripture witness intact, inspect what each states, and do not supply a combined sequence the sources do not author.

rightEvidence.title: Israel keeps Passover, eats land produce, and manna ends

payload.tension: The same date is kept in two locations, but the second account immediately marks a change in Israel’s food.
payload.title: Passover at Sinai and at Gilgal
